Note:
- Signed with the production Kuro Anime release certificate so it installs cleanly
  as an in-place upgrade over v1.5.3 without wiping user watch history or settings.
- GitHub Releases and main branch remain on v1.5.3 (official public release).

What's Included in 1.5.4-beta:
1. Unified Account, Trackers & Discord Rich Presence Hub (Proposal #3):
   - Kuro Cloud Account card with profile avatar/banner sync, instant Push / Pull
     Cloud Sync, Export / Import JSON backup, and Sign Out.
   - AniList 2-Way Sync (OAuth token connect, auto-update episode progress at 85%
     watched, full library import/sync).
   - MyAnimeList Sync (Client ID + username/token connect, library pull & episode push).
   - Discord Rich Presence (Live "Watching on Kuro" status with anime title, episode,
     elapsed timer, cover art, and custom Webhook / RPC bridge support).
   - Granular Sync Preferences toggles (Auto-push at 85% watched, Sync rewatch counts
     & scores, Broadcast Discord Rich Presence, Private / Incognito session).

2. 24 Real Manga Face PFPs & Matching 16:9 Banners (art-11 .. art-34):
   - Removed all 10 legacy overlay PFPs & banners (art-01 .. art-10) and replaced them
     with 24 authentic manga/manhwa face-only avatars (256x256 WebP) and 24 matching
     16:9 manga spread banners (1024x576 WebP), plus one-tap "Match banner" pairing:
     art-11 Satoru Gojo (Jujutsu Kaisen)        | art-23 Mash Burnedead (Mashle)
     art-12 Ryomen Sukuna (Jujutsu Kaisen)      | art-24 Goku (Dragon Ball Z)
     art-13 Yuta Okkotsu (Jujutsu Kaisen 0)     | art-25 Gabimaru (Hell's Paradise)
     art-14 Toji Fushiguro (Jujutsu Kaisen)     | art-26 Akame (Akame ga Kill!)
     art-15 Sung Jinwoo (Solo Leveling)         | art-27 Kaoruko Waguri (Fragrant Flower)
     art-16 Light Yagami (Death Note)           | art-28 Eren Yeager (Attack on Titan)
     art-17 Denji (Chainsaw Man)                | art-29 Levi Ackerman (Attack on Titan)
     art-18 Makima (Chainsaw Man)               | art-30 Nagumo (Sakamoto Days)
     art-19 Asta (Black Clover)                 | art-31 Ai Hoshino (Oshi no Ko)
     art-20 Ichigo Kurosaki (Bleach)            | art-32 Buddha (Record of Ragnarok)
     art-21 Sosuke Aizen (Bleach: TYBW)         | art-33 Johan Liebert (Monster)
     art-22 Frieren (Beyond Journey's End)      | art-34 Yuuichi Katagiri (Tomodachi Game)

3. Desktop Leanback Left-Rail UI (Proposal #3 — Desktop Mode Only):
   - Activates ONLY when Settings -> Appearance and startup -> Site view -> Desktop
     is enabled; Mobile mode keeps the standard mobile layout.
   - Collapsible glass left navigation rail, 16:9 widescreen hero spotlight,
     horizontal Continue Watching progress strip, and multi-column poster grid.

4. Cleanups & Fixes Carried Forward:
   - Hidden "Verify Library 11", "Surprise Me", and "Source sites · open separately"
     across Home and Settings.
   - Full v1.5.3 base (Miruro multi-server streaming, 1,100+ catalog, Cloud Sync,
     Custom Accent Colors, Ambient Glow, Sleep Timer, Playback Speed, Guest Sync prompt).
